name: dumbbell preacher curl over exercise ball
description: A preacher curl kneeling behind an exercise ball with the upper arms draped over it. It trains the biceps with some balance demand.
instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball and lean your chest against it.
Drape your upper arms over the ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms up.
Keep your upper arms on the ball and curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
